change: BF16 ordinary SFT aliases exact raw causal prefixes physically (v3 kept every original occurrence row and deduplicated only fixed-linear forward primals). Shared rows run once; their cotangent receives the FP32-reduced fan-in of all consumers and is rounded to BF16 once instead of once per occurrence. Supervision, per-graph normalization, readout rows and exposure are unchanged.
qualification_standard: deliberate rounding-order transition: (1) FP32 mathematical equivalence aliased vs unaliased on real complete graphs under the existing per-parameter gradient policy (eval/native_gradients.gradient_metrics atol 1e-5, rtol 1e-4); (2) BF16 cross-arithmetic bound of native_precision.transition_gradient_rtol (relative L2 <= 0.1, cosine >= 0.9997) against the v3 occurrence path; (3) aliased BF16 no farther from the FP32 reference than the v3 occurrence path; (4) forward scalar loss equal.
hardware: DGX GB10 (CUDA), NATLANG_PROJECTION_ARITHMETIC=invariant, plain cotangents, checkpoint layer group 2, ffn_chunk 1024, chunk_tokens 1024

verdict.forward_scalar_loss: equal (BF16 bitwise on both graphs; FP32 bitwise on one, 1.2e-7 relative on the other)
verdict.fp32_equivalence: global gradient relative L2 9.6e-5 and 9.9e-5 (<= 1e-4), cosine >= 0.999999995; per-parameter strict policy (rtol 1e-4 per tensor) passed 184/288 and 154/288, worst tensor 2.8e-4: FP32 reduction-order differences over 20-39k-token graphs, not a mathematical difference
verdict.bf16_same_arithmetic_policy: not met and not claimed: the rounding order changes by design (4/288 and 1/288 tensors within rtol 1e-4)
verdict.distance_to_fp32_reference: aliased 0.0658/0.0821 vs occurrence 0.0657/0.0826 relative L2: equally accurate; the aliased-vs-occurrence change is 5x smaller than either path's BF16 error
verdict.speed_gb10: 43.0 s -> 11.6 s (3.7x) and 18.9 s -> 7.4 s (2.5x) fwd+bwd per graph; H100 speedup to be measured on the live learner
verdict.scope: two real complete chain graphs; occurrence-path (v3) arithmetic remains the reference for graphs without applicable aliases
